rules.rule: `max` without `loop` stops with a message before any other step; it counts commits only
must: `max <n>` counts commits only
needs `loop`: given without it, say\s+\"`max` needs `loop`\" and stop before any other step

rules.rule: Without `loop` a run makes at most one change
must: Without `loop` a run makes\s+at most one change
Without `loop`, stop after\s+one change

rules.rule: A missing prerequisite is named and the run stops with no edit or commit; it never starts a server
must: The first that fails is named as the missing prerequisite
Never start one, even when the config says how
`HeadlessChrome`

rules.rule: Committing forbidden: ask leave once; without it list the findings and stop before any edit
must: asks leave to commit every change of this run
write no report, and stop before any edit

rules.rule: Measurable defects before heuristic ones, shared chrome and landing page first, ties to the smaller change
must: Measurable defects .{0,140}before named-heuristic\s+violations with a concrete fix
shared chrome .{0,80}and the landing page before deeper pages
Ties go to the smaller change

rules.rule: Only a `UX:` comment binds; tests and earlier commits do not
must: only binding previous decision
Never act against one unless a focus says to
Test assertions and\s+earlier commits do not bind

rules.rule: A focus is an instruction that beats a `UX:` comment and limits the commit to the focused part
must: implement it even when it is a product decision
It beats a `UX:`\s+comment, which the same commit removes
no commit touches markup or styles outside the\s+focused part

rules.rule: One commit per UX change; one rule in several places is one commit with a pair per place
must: One commit per UX change
unrelated changes never share a commit

rules.rule: Before and after pictures of every touched view; each commit deletes the pictures it did not write
must: Before any edit, delete every untracked `dev/ux/\*\.png`
every tracked `dev/ux/\*\.png` this commit\s+did not write

rules.rule: Checks gate every commit on exit status; new red gets one repair, then auto discards
must: re-run the checks gated on exit status
never on piped or filtered output
gets one repair; still red: under\s+`auto`, discard the change

rules.rule: cm at mini plus three UX fields at 72 columns; no extra trailer
must: Invoke `craft:cm` at `mini`
`none` for a\s+comment-only commit
Never add a trailer beyond what `cm` allows

rules.rule: Interactive stops take commit, drop, or a prompt; drops last the run; a prompt never commits
must: Drops are remembered for the current\s+run only
with no commit in between
`docs\(ux\): never <x>`

rules.rule: Loop runs until no measurable or named-heuristic finding qualifies, or `max` commits
must: No cap by default
when\s+the run has made `max` commits

rules.rule: Report opens with counts and stop reason read off git log
must: 3 commits, 1 dropped; stopped: stop rule
Read every count and hash off `git log

rules.rule: The audit never changes the app's stored data
must: Never click logout, nor submit, delete, or otherwise\s+change data the app stores
